title: Six and seven loop Konishi from Luscher corrections
claim: Six- and seven-loop planar Konishi from Luscher corrections with the worldsheet S-matrix; integrand derived analytically, integral and infinite sum evaluated by high-precision numerics and asymptotic expansion, integer coefficients of zeta values fitted; seven loops is the limit of the approach because double wrapping enters at eight loops.
scheme: No regularization: not a DR (or any Feynman-graph) computation. Planar spectrum obtained from the integrable AdS5 x S5 worldsheet S-matrix (asymptotic Bethe ansatz with BES/BHL dressing phase) plus finite-size corrections. Single-wrapping Luscher corrections; analytic result reconstructed by fitting integer coefficients of zeta values to numerics.

assumed: all-loop integrability of planar N=4 SYM / AdS5 x S5 superstring
asymptotic Bethe ansatz with the BES/BHL dressing phase (exact worldsheet S-matrix)
identification of gauge-theory anomalous dimensions with string energies (AdS/CFT) in the planar limit
single-wrapping Luscher formula sufficient through seven loops
ansatz of integer combinations of zeta values for the fit

evidence: Abstract (paraphrased): numerics + fit; double wrapping at eight loops
red_flags: analytic coefficients obtained by numerical fitting to an assumed basis
